findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Gate - The full suite still asserts the old Claude-only setting and fails with split workers.
Case: normal use - running the configured full suite or the nightly full-suite check.
`tests/test_fix_the_owner_moved_this_repo_s_workers_from.py:50` asserts that `workers` is `claude`, although this line sets it to `split`. Its fix case also expects a Claude turn, and its doctor case at line 114 rejects the hook-approval note that `src/forge/doctor.py:352` and line 513 produce for split workers. `tests/test_source_split_workers.py:30`–35 expects the non-user-facing task to use Claude and no Codex, although `src/forge/repo.py:847`–850 routes it to Codex. Update those tests and their stubs for the split routes.
